activity_summary: After the lovers, Phillips said Nick came in under the note and that the mornings still stand. Burbage had not needed to carry him. You told Nick the court room wants him lower, not higher, and that tomorrow is no experiment. You called today the third time and Saturday the fourth, if the bill holds. No cloak was chosen tonight. Nick went to Aldermanbury with the cold in his hands and the note in his mouth.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Set tomorrow as the same note, and Saturday as not yet.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Kept the mornings, and sent him to warm his hands.

entities.name: Nick Sorrell
entities.context: Named the cold and the note as two different things, and went to Aldermanbury.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Said his hand was not needed, and refused to invent a cloak tonight.

facets.activity: Heard Nick under the note and called Saturday the fourth

quotes.speaker: richard_burbage
quotes.text: I did not need it today. He finished her himself.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Saturday is the fourth, if the bill holds. Do not spend it early.

quotes.speaker: nick_sorrell
quotes.text: The cold is in the hands. The note is in the mouth.

quotes.speaker: augustine_phillips
quotes.text: I am not cancelling a morning because an afternoon was brave.
